messages.subject: Re: MaAsLin questions
parts:
Hi Liz - many thanks for getting in touch; I've CCed in the MaAsLin users group to chime in, but my short version would be that it's typically best to use very targeted tests for small sample sizes, making MaAsLin's multivariate model more appropriate for larger / more complicated study designs.  LEfSe was originally designed for cases like that, and more recent methods like MetaStats and PhyloSeq are similarly intended for simpler, smaller designs, if that's the main regime you'll be working in.

Thanks again -
Curtis
